Practice Support, Dube & Dorsey LLP"},{"spec_id":"spec_0789","text":"Summitpath Site - Reuse Ideas Brainstorm
Wednesday 1:00 PM - 2:30 PM
Location: City Hall, Room 210 / Microsoft Teams
Required: Rafael Gunawardena; Carmen Fairweather; Sana Jovanovic
Organizer: Gemma

Hi folks,

Council's asked us to come back next month with two or three honest-to-goodness options for the old Summitpath site, and I'd rather we cook those up together than trade memos for six weeks. Bring your wild ideas and your sensible ones.

Here's the plan:
1. Where things stand (Rafael, 10 min): soil report, zoning limits, what the deed restrictions let us do.
2. Neighbors' wish list (Sana, 15 min): highlights from the spring listening sessions and survey comments.
3. Money picture (Carmen, 15 min): grant windows we could chase and what the capital budget can stomach.
4. Open brainstorm (all, 40 min): park, housing, mixed use, something nobody's thought of. We'll sketch on the whiteboard.
5. Narrow it down (Gemma, 10 min): pick the top three to flesh out and who takes each.

If you can, skim the site map I sent around Friday before we meet. Coffee's on me.

Thanks kindly,
Gemma
City of Brightline Planning & Development
